name: Lookup member savings balance
description: Looks up a member in the local legacy core console and returns the member name and current savings balance.

member_id.description: Member number supplied by the calling agent. Stored as a parameter, not as a literal artifact value.

member_found.description: False when the member lookup returns a known not-found outcome.

member_name.description: Visible member name from the profile screen.

savings_balance.description: Visible savings balance exactly as displayed by the application.

steps.description: The goal requires member data, so open the member servicing module from the operator home screen.

target.css: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(2) > a
target.rationale: Visible link text is stable across branded tenant variants even when DOM ids are absent.

steps.description: The member lookup screen has a row-labeled member/account input. Use a parameter instead of recording the literal value.

target.label: Member / Account Number
target.css: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > form > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(1) > td:nth-of-type(2) > input
target.rationale: Legacy table row labels are more robust here than generated CSS paths.

steps.description: Submit the lookup form after the parameterized member id has been entered.

target.css: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > form > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(3) > td:nth-of-type(2) > button
target.rationale: Button text is short, visible, and stable for replay.

steps.description: The search results contain a matching member row; open the profile detail page.

target.css: body > div:nth-of-type(3) > table > tbody > tr:nth-of-type(2) > td:nth-of-type(4) > a
target.rationale: The profile link is identified by its visible action text rather than a brittle table coordinate alone.

steps.description: Capture the member name output from the profile table row.

target.label: Member Name
target.rationale: The value is the sibling cell next to a stable row label.

steps.description: Read the current savings balance from the detail page.

target.label: Savings Balance
target.rationale: The balance is stored as a visible table value adjacent to its label, matching many legacy back-office screens.

steps.description: Verify the final state before saving the capability.

target.rationale: This checkpoint confirms the run reached the expected profile page.

business_outcomes.message: The target application completed the lookup and reported no matching member.

escalated.behavior: pause same session and transfer control

tenant_model.drift_detection: Replay records locator fallback used, checkpoint result, screenshots on failure, and can be replayed as a tenant smoke test.
